36: function formatPromptValue(value: unknown): string {
37:   if (value === null) {
38:     return 'null';

41:     return `[${value.map(formatPromptValue).join(',')}]`;
42:   }
43:   if (typeof value === 'object') {
44:     const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
45:     return `{${Object.keys(record)
46:       .sort()
47:       .map((key) => `${key}:${formatPromptValue(record[key])}`)

137:     allowedTools?: string[];
138:     predecidedActions?: PredecidedAction[];
139:     workspaceId: string;
140:     contactId: string;
141:     phone: string;
142:     message: string;
143:     context?: UnknownRecord;
144:   }): Promise<{
145:     actions: ActionEntry[];
146:     response?: string;
147:     intent: string;
148:     confidence: number;
149:   }> {
150:     const { workspaceId, contactId, phone, message, context } = params;
151: 
152:     const predecidedActions = params.predecidedActions ?? [];
153: 
154:     if (!this.openai && predecidedActions.length === 0) {
155:       this.logger.warn('OpenAI not configured');
156:       return this.response.buildFallbackResult(message);
157:     }
158: 
159:     // 1. Load workspace / contact / history / products in parallel
160:     const [workspace, contact, conversationHistory, products] = await Promise.all([
161:       this.ctx.getWorkspaceContext(workspaceId),
162:       this.ctx.getContactContext(workspaceId, contactId, phone),
163:       this.ctx.getConversationHistory(workspaceId, contactId, 0, phone),
164:       this.ctx.getProducts(workspaceId),
165:     ]);
166: 
167:     // 1b. Load AI config per product (commercial brain)
168:     const productIds = products
169:       .map((product: UnknownRecord) => {
170:         const productValue = this.ctx.readRecord(product.value);
171:         return this.ctx.readOptionalText(productValue.id) || this.ctx.readOptionalText(product.id);
172:       })
173:       .filter((productId): productId is string => Boolean(productId));
174:     let aiConfigs: UnknownRecord[] = [];
175:     if (productIds.length > 0) {
176:       try {
177:         aiConfigs = await this.prisma.productAIConfig.findMany({
178:           take: 50,
179:           where: { productId: { in: productIds } },
180:           select: {
181:             id: true,
182:             productId: true,
183:             tone: true,
184:             persistenceLevel: true,
185:             messageLimit: true,
186:             customerProfile: true,
187:             positioning: true,
188:             objections: true,
189:             salesArguments: true,
190:           },
191:         });
192:       } catch {
193:         /* ProductAIConfig may not exist yet */
194:       }
195:     }
196: 
197:     const compressedContext = await this.ctx.buildAndPersistCompressedContext(
198:       workspaceId,
199:       contactId,
200:       phone,
201:       contact,
202:     );
203:     const tacticalHint = this.ctx.buildLeadTacticalHint({
204:       leadName: this.ctx.isRecord(contact) ? this.ctx.readText(contact.name).trim() : '',
205:       currentMessage: message,
206:       conversationHistory,
207:     });
208: 
209:     // 2. Build system prompt and style instruction
210:     const agentRuntimeContext = await this.buildAgentRuntimeContext({
211:       workspaceId,
212:       channel: this.ctx.readText(context?.channel, 'whatsapp'),
213:       message,
214:       contactId,
215:       ...(params.allowedTools !== undefined ? { allowedTools: params.allowedTools } : {}),
216:     });
217:     const systemPrompt = [
218:       this.ctx.buildSystemPrompt(workspace, products, aiConfigs),
219:       agentRuntimeContext.systemPromptBlock,
220:     ].join('\n\n');
221:     const stylePolicy = this.response.buildReplyStyleInstruction(
222:       message,
223:       conversationHistory.length,
224:     );
225:     const contactData: Record<string, unknown> = this.ctx.isRecord(contact) ? contact : {};
226:     const contactName = this.ctx.readText(contactData.name).trim() || phone;
227:     const contactSentiment = this.ctx.readText(contactData.sentiment).trim() || 'NEUTRAL';
228:     const leadScore = this.ctx.readText(contactData.leadScore, '0');
229:     const tagNames = this.ctx.readTagList(contactData.tags);
230: 
231:     // 3. Build messages array
232:     const additionalContext = context ? formatPromptValue(context) : '';
233:     const currentInput = {
234:       raw: message,
235:       channel: this.ctx.readText(context?.channel, 'whatsapp'),
236:       arrivalTimestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
237:     };
238:     let cognitiveState: Record<string, unknown> = {
239:       abiStatus: this.abiBuilder ? 'unavailable_or_invalid' : 'builder_not_injected',
240:       audience: 'public',
241:       perceptionSnapshot: { channel: currentInput.channel },
242:     };
243: 
244:     if (this.abiBuilder) {
245:       const abiResult = await this.abiBuilder.build({
246:         audience: 'public',
247:         currentInput,
248:         perceptionSnapshot: {
249:           channel: currentInput.channel,
250:         },
251:       });
252: 
253:       if (abiResult.status !== 'ok') {
254:         this.logger.warn(
255:           `ABI build failed: ${abiResult.reason}, using structured unified agent fallback`,
256:         );
257:       } else {
258:         const abi = abiResult.abi;
259:         const validation = validateAbiPayload(abi);
260: 
261:         if (validation.status === 'FAIL') {
262:           this.logger.warn(
263:             `ABI validation failed: ${JSON.stringify(validation.issues)}, using structured unified agent fallback`,
264:           );
265:         } else {
266:           cognitiveState = abi as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
267:         }
268:       }
269:     }

271:     const messages: ChatCompletionMessageParam[] = [
272:       ...conversationHistory,
273:       {
274:         role: 'user',
275:         content: JSON.stringify({
276:           cognitiveState,
277:           runtimeContext: {
278:             workspaceProductContext: systemPrompt,
279:             compressedMemory: compressedContext || null,
280:             additionalContext,
281:             tacticalHint:
282:               tacticalHint || 'responder com clareza, valor concreto e próximo passo.',
283:             responsePolicy: stylePolicy,
284:           },
285:           contact: {
286:             name: contactName,
287:             sentiment: contactSentiment,
288:             leadScore,
289:             tags: tagNames,
290:           },
291:           currentInput,
292:         }),
293:       },
294:     ];

296:     if (predecidedActions.length > 0) {
297:       const actionsList = await executePredecidedAgentActions({
298:         ...(params.allowedTools !== undefined ? { allowedTools: params.allowedTools } : {}),
299:         contactId,
300:         ...(context !== undefined ? { context } : {}),
301:         executeTool: this.executeToolAction.bind(this),
302:         logAutopilotEvent: this.actions.logAutopilotEvent.bind(this.actions),
303:         phone,
304:         predecidedActions,
305:         workspaceId,
306:       });
307:       const intent = this.response.extractIntent(actionsList, message);
308:       const draftedReply = await this.response.composeWriterReply(
309:         this.openai,
310:         this.writerModel,
311:         this.fallbackWriterModel,
312:         {
313:           workspaceId,
314:           customerMessage: message,
315:           assistantDraft: buildPredecidedActionDraft(actionsList),
316:           actions: actionsList,
317:           historyTurns: conversationHistory.length,
318:         },
319:       );

321:       await this.recordAgentRuntimeTurn({
322:         workspaceId,
323:         channel: this.ctx.readText(context?.channel, 'whatsapp'),
324:         userMessage: message,
325:         ...(draftedReply !== undefined ? { assistantMessage: draftedReply } : {}),
326:         contactId,
327:         intent,
328:         confidence: actionsList.length > 0 ? 0.85 : 0.55,
329:         actions: actionsList.map((action) => ({
330:           toolName: action.tool,
331:           success: this.actionSucceeded(action.result),
332:           result: action.result,
333:         })),
334:       });

336:       return {
337:         actions: actionsList,
338:         ...(draftedReply !== undefined ? { response: draftedReply } : {}),
339:         intent,
340:         confidence: actionsList.length > 0 ? 0.85 : 0.55,
341:       };
342:     }

344:     // 4. Ask the LLM to verbalize only; code-native actions enter via predecidedActions.
345:     let llmResponse: OpenAI.Chat.ChatCompletion;
346:     try {
347:       await this.planLimits.ensureTokenBudget(params.workspaceId);
348:       const openai = this.openai;
349:       if (!openai) {
350:         const error = new Error();
351:         error.message = UNIFIED_AGENT_PROVIDER_CONFIG_REQUIRED;
352:         throw error;
353:       }
354:       llmResponse = await chatCompletionWithFallback(
355:         openai,
356:         {
357:           model: this.primaryBrainModel,
358:           messages,
359:           temperature: 0.82,
360:           top_p: 0.9,
361:         },
362:         this.fallbackBrainModel,
363:       );
364:     } catch (err: unknown) {
365:       const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : typeof err === 'string' ? err : 'unknown';
366:       this.logger.error(`OpenAI agent processing failed, using fallback: ${msg}`);
367:       return this.response.buildFallbackResult(message);
368:     }
369:     if (!llmResponse) {
370:       return this.response.buildFallbackResult(message);
371:     }
372:     const firstChoice = llmResponse.choices[0];
373:     if (!firstChoice) {
374:       return this.response.buildFallbackResult(message);
375:     }
376:     await this.planLimits
377:       .trackAiUsage(params.workspaceId, llmResponse.usage?.total_tokens ?? 500)
378:       .catch(() => {});
379: 
380:     const assistantMessage = firstChoice.message;
381:     const actionsList: ActionEntry[] = [];
382: 
383:     // 5. Process tool calls
384:     const executeTools = context?.executeTools !== false;
385:     if (executeTools && assistantMessage.tool_calls && assistantMessage.tool_calls.length > 0) {
386:       await forEachSequential(assistantMessage.tool_calls, async (toolCall) => {
387:         if (toolCall.type !== 'function') {
388:           return;
389:         }
390:         const toolName = toolCall.function.name;
391:         if (!isAllowedTool(toolName, params.allowedTools)) {
392:           this.logger.warn(
393:             `Blocked disallowed agent tool call: workspaceId=${workspaceId} tool=${toolName}`,
394:           );
395:           const blockedResult = { blocked: true, reason: 'capability_not_allowed' };
396:           actionsList.push({ tool: toolName, args: {}, result: blockedResult });
397:           await this.actions.logAutopilotEvent(workspaceId, contactId, toolName, {}, blockedResult);
398:           return;
399:         }
400:         let toolArgs: Record<string, unknown> = {};
401:         try {
402:           toolArgs = JSON.parse(toolCall.function.arguments || '{}');
403:         } catch {
404:           this.logger.warn(`Failed to parse tool args for ${toolName}`);
405:         }
406:         const result = await this.executeToolAction(
407:           workspaceId,
408:           contactId,
409:           phone,
410:           toolName,
411:           toolArgs,
412:           context,
413:         );
414:         actionsList.push({ tool: toolName, args: toolArgs, result });
415:         await this.actions.logAutopilotEvent(workspaceId, contactId, toolName, toolArgs, result);
416:       });
417:     }

419:     // 6. Extract intent, confidence, and compose final reply
420:     const intent = this.response.extractIntent(actionsList, message);
421:     const confidence = this.response.calculateConfidence(actionsList, llmResponse);
422:     const draftedReply = await this.response.composeWriterReply(
423:       this.openai,
424:       this.writerModel,
425:       this.fallbackWriterModel,
426:       {
427:         workspaceId,
428:         customerMessage: message,
429:         assistantDraft: assistantMessage.content,
430:         actions: actionsList,
431:         historyTurns: conversationHistory.length,
432:       },
433:     );

436:       workspaceId,
437:       channel: this.ctx.readText(context?.channel, 'whatsapp'),
438:       userMessage: message,
439:       ...(draftedReply !== undefined ? { assistantMessage: draftedReply } : {}),
440:       contactId,
441:       intent,
442:       confidence,
443:       actions: actionsList.map((action) => ({
444:         toolName: action.tool,
445:         success: this.actionSucceeded(action.result),
446:         result: action.result,
447:       })),
448:     });
449: 
450:     return {
451:       actions: actionsList,
452:       ...(draftedReply !== undefined ? { response: draftedReply } : {}),
453:       intent,
454:       confidence,
455:     };
456:   }
